{{Quote|You spent seven seasons with the Circus Horrificus, training their specimens without being eaten. That's a record for them, you know.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to Malakili|<ref name="A Boy and His Monster: The Rancor Keeper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Boy and His Monster: The Rancor Keeper's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>}}
'''Circus Horrificus''' was a traveling [[Circus/Legends|circus]] that was very popular around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The circus usually included gladiatorial events which pitted one or more beings against savage creatures from around the galaxy. It was overseen by a [[Unidentified Circus Horrificus ringmaster|ringmaster]]. Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Circus was involved in an illegal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring of [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]] which was exposed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]].

After a particularly nasty controversy where an [[arqet]] escaped and [[Death/Legends|killed]] twelve audience members in the lower levels of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the Circus all but faded into obscurity. Around this time, the [[Unidentified Circus Horrificus ringmaster|owner]] sold his wrangler, [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the circus visited [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During their stay, the Circus staff apparently "misplaced" some sick animals. Some time after their departure, the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]] got reports that these creatures miraculously recovered from their illnesses and were threatening the safety of nearby [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. As tracking and removing these creatures could have turned into an time-consuming endeavor, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Peers]] hired a civilian hunter to deal with the beasts.<ref name="SWG:CHLaM" />
